verdict.rationale: Puzzle offers a natural-language Q&A feature ('Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English') and an AI Close feature for document import/categorization, suggesting some natural-language interaction with the product. However, evidence doesn't show broad natural-language command coverage across all product actions (e.g., setting up rules, migrations, reporting) beyond Q&A and categorization. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands controlling broader workflows/actions beyond Q&A, independent/hands-on confirmation of NL command reliability, and a documented breadth of NL-driven operations across the product.
